name: 2029 S. Indiana Avenue — the dwelling on the church's lot, on the alley (district draft; refined by T-3014)

function.note: The 1911 sheet reads 'A 2B brick dwelling (D) with a 1B brick piece on the alley, behind the church (216 E. 21st Street rides on this lot)'. A dwelling on the church's lot, drawn at its 1911 envelope. Carried to 1904 on the T-3009 census ruling (present_as_mapped).

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-3009, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-3014 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 35w trace (s35wfp-indiana_2029-b2), the T-3009 census (s35w-2029-rear) and the T-1837 register row frontage-35w-2029–2035; every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-district-background-3009).

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-3009 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

position.note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 0.750, v 2.000 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet's georeference carries no independent check: its own fit residual is 0.05 m RMS on its control crossings, a similarity on two degrees of freedom that says little away from them, plus about a pixel (0.19 m) of trace on this coarser copy. Rotation 179.247 degrees turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.
